description: Each rule r1 to r40 reaches the rule before it through two wrappers, a and b, and the input is empty, so every item spans the same. No rule can complete again below itself, so no cycle context holds a rule. A context of every rule above would differ by the path through a or b, and their number would double at each level (engine §6).
